CAVEAT: per the underlying Truong et al. (2025, 'Fantastic Bugs and Where to Find Them in AI Benchmarks', NeurIPS 2025, arXiv:2511.16842), these figures are precision@50 of a flagging method (Precision@k = TP(k)/k among the top-k flagged items), not benchmark-wide invalid-item rates. The same authors put GSM8K's error rate at 'as high as 5%---a total of 88 questions'.
